propositions: apply_inbound_records.py at 799 LOC exceeds the 800-LOC module-size cap and blocks further modifications due to CI gate enforcement

The module contains two disjoint concern clusters: event-file materialisation (MOVES to apply_inbound_events.py) and rebar-facade mutation (STAYS in apply_inbound_records.py) that share only logging imports

Cluster A (event materialisation) comprises _RECONCILER_MARKER_APPLIER, four _inbound_create_* phase helpers, and four _inbound_update_* event writers, all terminating in inbound_translate._write_event_file
Cluster B (facade mutation) comprises identity minting and closed link management functions that write through rebar facades and optional stores, never writing event files
Two existing tests monkeypatch and capture logs on apply_inbound_records module objects directly and must not be moved to preserve test validity
Moved segments are byte-identical except for two function-local imports of _ensure_inbound_assignee_identity; path-keyed anchors in tests and docs are retargeted to the new module locations
